units.source_text: 这是一副紧蹙双眉、白皙、机敏的侧脸，一看他的制帽，就知道他是京都大学的学生。

en.t: It was a pale, alert profile with tightly knitted brows, and one glance at his student cap told me he was a student at Kyoto University.
He glanced at me out of the corner of his eye.

units.source_text: 这是一双活像浓重的影子流泻过来的视线。

en.t: It was a gaze that seemed just like a dense shadow pouring over me.

units.source_text: 这时候，我直觉地感到"他无疑是个纵火者"。

en.t: At that moment, I felt instinctively that he was undoubtedly an arsonist.
